name: La Condamine down the Amazon
summary: After eight years measuring a degree of latitude near Quito to settle the shape of the Earth, La Condamine goes home the long way: down the Amazon on a raft and canoes, mapping the river with compass and astronomy. He brings rubber and curare to the notice of European science.

stops.note: The French geodesic mission has measured an arc of the meridian.
Shoots the gorge of the Marañón on a raft.
Fixes positions by the stars as he goes.
Hears of a channel linking the Amazon to the Orinoco.
Measures the tides at the mouth.
On to French Guiana and home to Paris in 1745.
